For visitors

Potomac Pedalers is a membership club; check its ‘Ride with us’ page for how guests join. No cue sheets, so stay with the group. A longer ride runs on federal holidays.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
A/BB/B pace, moderate hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the The Usual Monday Ride from Glen Echo group ride

The Usual Monday Ride from Glen Echo is a road group ride in Glen Echo, MD. It rolls every Monday at 10:00 am from Glen Echo, MD.

A weekly Monday-morning road ride of about 30 miles through the rolling streets of Bethesda, Potomac and Travilah. The route is at the ride leaders’ whim, so there are no cue sheets. The group regroups at decision points and at the tops of big climbs, and often stops for coffee near the end.
